name: CHEM 1128Q
title: General Chemistry II
description: Equilibrium, thermodynamics, nuclear chemistry, and kinetics. Properties of some of the more familiar elements and their compounds. Equilibrium in solutions and reactions of the common cations and anions in the laboratory component. CA 3-LAB.
requirement_description: CHEM 1127Q, 1137Q, or 1147Q. Not open to students who have passed CHEM 1126Q or 1138Q or 1148Q.
